com.saicone.ezlib

Annotation Type Repository


  • @Documented
 @Target(value=TYPE)
 @Retention(value=RUNTIME)
public @interface Repository
    Specifies a repository that can be used to download dependencies.

    • Optional Element Summary

      Optional Elements 
      Modifier and Type Optional Element and Description
      boolean allowInsecureProtocol
      Allow downloads from repository with insecure protocol.
      Take in count this value doesn't hide the warning when insecure protocol is used.
      java.lang.String file
      File name to save repository information.
      java.lang.String format
      Url download format.
      java.lang.String name
      Repository name.
      java.lang.String url
      Repository url.

    • Element Detail

      • name

        public abstract java.lang.String name
        Repository name.
        Returns:
        repository unique name.
        Default:
        ""

      • url

        public abstract java.lang.String url
        Repository url.
        Returns:
        repository connection url.
        Default:
        ""

      • format

        public abstract java.lang.String format
        Url download format.
        Returns:
        url format to download files from repository.
        Default:
        "%group%/%artifact%/%version%/%artifact%-%fileVersion%.%fileType%"

      • file

        public abstract java.lang.String file
        File name to save repository information.
        Returns:
        file name.
        Default:
        "ezlib-dependencies.json"

      • allowInsecureProtocol

        public abstract boolean allowInsecureProtocol
        Allow downloads from repository with insecure protocol.
        Take in count this value doesn't hide the warning when insecure protocol is used.
        Returns:
        true if this repository will be used despite using an insecure protocol.
        Default:
        false
